tasks.short: Collect actual underwater samples or photographs and document vessel or structure condition.

steps.what: Understand actual inspection requirements and verify vessel or structure identification and collection scope
inputs: actual inspection brief supplied by inspection lead
outputs: understood collection scope and verified asset reference

steps.what: Take actual test samples or photographs underwater and capture their real location and context
inputs: understood collection scope and verified asset reference
outputs: actual collected samples or photographs with diver-captured location and context

steps.what: Write the actual collection index and attach photographs or sample references to the inspection record
inputs: actual collected samples or photographs with diver-captured location and context
understood collection scope and verified asset reference
outputs: authored inspection collection index and contextual notes

steps.what: Check sample or photograph correspondence and record actual observed condition limitations
inputs: authored inspection collection index and contextual notes
actual collected samples or photographs with diver-captured location and context
outputs: checked internal collection record with condition limitations

tasks.design: Use native asset-linked inspection attachment fields and a collection-index template for actual samples and photographs after collection. Remove repeated asset-reference and index-layout entry only; retain underwater work, fresh location/context capture, condition judgement, correspondence checks and ordinary internal saves.
tasks.previous_blocker: Collection indexes can repeat stable asset references and document layout after physical inspection.
tasks.enabler_now: Native inspection records and attachment templates can reuse the already selected asset context.
tasks.still_hard: Sample suitability, actual location and observed condition remain physical and professional judgements.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize that a photograph or sample is not representative of the relevant structure condition.
tasks.altitude: Keep collections traceable without replacing physical inspection.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: asset-linked inspection forms can reuse stable references while actual underwater sampling, photography and contextual observations remain human.

assumptions: OPS_SYSTEM is the actual inspection/work-order record module. Shares15/65/15/5 are provisional, not measured. s2 counts actual fresh context capture; s3 removes3 repeated asset-reference/layout points only, retaining12 of fresh index and contextual entry. Existing camera timestamps and automatic filenames receive no credit.

This scenario includes the diver's actual collection record, not a newly invented inspection report. If another role alone owns the index, map their labour separately and reweight the diver's actual work. No generated condition inference, sample analysis, free transcript, external report send or automated dive action is proposed. Ordinary internal saves are retained and ungated.
unknowns: Which index and attachment entry does the diver actually own?
research_questions: Compare real collection records with actual samples/photos for identity and context correspondence.

incremental.description: Maintain actual asset-context and collection-index fields.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes3 repeated index-reference/layout points less0.6 upkeep. Low: poor photo metadata and mixed structure references require manual correspondence work, leaving0.8 stable inspection-heading points removable, less0.6 upkeep. Scope verification15, underwater collection/capture65 and full correspondence check5 remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Supervise or train actual divers, including hobby divers.

steps.what: Establish actual diver needs, abilities and the scope of supervision or training
outputs: understood diver needs and session scope

steps.what: Prepare actual session materials from verified existing training-page structures
inputs: understood diver needs and session scope
actual verified training materials maintained by training provider
outputs: prepared session materials checked for actual context

steps.what: Supervise or train actual divers and capture direct observations of their practice
inputs: prepared session materials checked for actual context
outputs: actual supervised practice and instructor-captured observations

steps.what: Assess actual understanding and practice and provide direct session feedback
inputs: actual supervised practice and instructor-captured observations
outputs: actual feedback and follow-up captured by instructor

steps.what: Write actual assigned session observations and follow-up in the internal training record
inputs: actual supervised practice and instructor-captured observations
actual feedback and follow-up captured by instructor

tasks.design: Reuse native training-page structures for actual session preparation where existing verified materials fit. Keep diver assessment, actual supervision or instruction, direct feedback, fresh observation capture and assigned post-session notes; no generated diving procedure, automated supervision or competence certification is proposed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated page preparation can recur when using verified training materials.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document styles reuse presentation while the instructor checks actual applicability.
tasks.still_hard: Actual safe practice and understanding require direct professional observation.
tasks.human_edge: Notice a diver's difficulty that a completed record does not reveal.
tasks.altitude: Spend less preparation time on page setup and retain direct instruction.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native training-page styles reduce presentation setup but cannot supervise divers, assess actual practice or certify competence.

assumptions: Shares10/15/60/10/5 are provisional training-session allocations, not measured. s2 removes3 repeated presentation points, retaining12 for actual content and applicability. Supervision and training are alternative session contexts; do not assume both activities happen in every episode.

s3/s4 count actual fresh observation and feedback capture; s5 only actual assigned written records after the session. Remove/reweight if another role owns the record. For supervision-only work without material preparation, remove s2 and assess that actual work rather than invent pages. Ordinary author saves remain retained and ungated.
unknowns: How often does actual owned training preparation recur rather than supervision alone?
research_questions: Observe page setup separately from actual supervision and direct feedback.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High for a recurring training session removes3 repeated page-setup points less0.5 upkeep. Low: supervision-only work has no training pages to prepare, so no page-setup benefit exists and net benefit floors at0 after upkeep; assess that actual reweighted session. Diver needs, live supervision/instruction, direct assessment and actual records remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Retain underwater and instructional judgement while simplifying actual collection and training presentation records.
skills_to_grow: Separate session observation from completion records
role.ambitious_version: Use traceable collection records and verified training materials without delegating diving actions or actual supervision.
